coordinates: Indices are 0-based event positions in the #7623 word. "delete" lists [index, event]; an insert goes immediately before base event "before" (inserts with the same "before" keep list order). Applied to the INTERIOR subsequence (every MOVE/INIT/CLEAR and every ADD/COPY/SCALE at a chart of dimension 1..8), the 23 deletions and 12 insertions give the interior subsequence of the new word exactly. initial[h] changes for the two rebirths.
hub_resettle: Joint hub re-settle: every ADD/SCALE at the {0} chart (dimension 0) and at the full chart V (dimension 9) is re-derived. The {0} prefix (helpers born at {0}) and the V mix (registers ending at V) are solved jointly and exactly so that every final row equals #7623's, then factored into ADD/SCALE events with 5-smooth coefficients. Dimension-0/9 ADD+SCALE events: 61,251 -> 192,723.

edits.what: Helper 457 was born at the {0} chart 3 and moved straight to its first chart 281 (dim 3). It is now born at 281 (its first MOVE is deleted). While its row is still exactly e_457, the depth-1 canceller 242 += -1*457 is placed at 281, before 457's first op; 242 is a {0}-born helper that ends at V, so the token e_457 rides out on a register whose content the V mix settles. Helper target rank 9 -> 6.
Same as E1 for helper 461, born at 285 (dim 3); canceller 10 += -1*461 at 285, where 10 is a kept X main (it ends at V). Helper target rank 9 -> 6.
